headline: عندما لا يصل الوكيل إلى رقم قابل للحساب: هل يبرر فريق من الوكلاء كلفة أعلى بـ4.5 مرات؟
reviewer: AI editorial review (not a human reader test)
summary: اختبرت الدراسة 100 مهمة علمية؛ تجاوزت تسعة إعدادات متعددة الوكلاء خط الأساس، لكن أقوى درجة احتاجت نحو 4.5 أمثال الزمن، وكان المكسب أساساً في بلوغ حساب واقعي.

source_evidence.claim: Nine of ten MAS configurations exceed the 11.0 GPT-5 baseline
source_evidence.assessment: Composite score, not accuracy; five methods under two protocols

source_evidence.claim: GPTSwarm category 32.0 at about 4.5x time; W4S task 29.4 at 1.85x
source_evidence.assessment: Absolute performance and cost efficiency select different workflows

source_evidence.claim: Strict task win rate 51/100; 49/100 not higher
source_evidence.assessment: Remainder can include ties and lower scores

source_evidence.claim: ScienceAgentBench side sample: 102 tasks from 44 papers and four disciplines
source_evidence.assessment: Independent context only; source-reported rounded percentages

decision: BLOCKED pending actual mobile viewport/browser verification and successful GitHub Actions confirmation
terminology_evidence: MAS, composite score, realistic output, conditional pass rate, task win rate, inference time and held-out query are defined.
language_evidence: Problem-first Arabic passed a 30-word comprehension simulation; all reconstructable proportions carry numerator and denominator.
